_comment: Search normalization vectors (issue #281, Workstream E). One table-driven normalizeForSearch contract applied at every lexical FTS write site, the desktop query (sanitizeFtsQuery), the browser keyword index (add + search), packtool (build + compose), the interop harness writers + oracle, and the Python twin contracts/tests/store-interop/normalize_search.py. Semantics (pinned by these vectors): NFKC, strip Default_Ignorable code points (U+00AD, U+200B, U+200C, U+200D, U+2060, U+FEFF), fold dash variants (U+2010-U+2015, U+2212) to '-', quote variants (U+2018/U+2019 to apostrophe, U+201C/U+201D to double quote), U+2026 to '...', NBSP/NNBSP to space (already NFKC), collapse whitespace runs to one space, trim. Greek and CJK letters preserved. Consumers: desktop text-normalization-vectors.test.ts, web_ui keyword-index.normalization.test.ts, packtool index-writer-normalization.test.ts, python tests/test_text_normalization_vectors.py, interop harness legs.

vectors.note: U+00AD from mammoth w:softHyphen splits the token for unicode61
U+FB02 fl ligature, NFKC compatibility fold
U+FB03 ffi ligature folds to ffi
fullwidth A folds to ASCII A
fullwidth e folds to ASCII e
U+FF02 NFKC-folds to ASCII double quote
soft hyphen + ZWSP in one word
Greek letters preserved (ClipSanitizer lossy half must NOT be carried)
whitespace runs collapse to one space
U+0085 is NOT whitespace in the JS set - kept verbatim (python str-backslash-s would fold it; the shared explicit class keeps twins identical, impl-review r1)
U+001C is NOT whitespace in the JS set - kept verbatim (same parity rationale)
BOUNDARY (impl-review r2): a LEADING U+0085 is kept verbatim - python str.strip() no-args would drop it; the JS .trim() set also keeps it
BOUNDARY (impl-review r2): a TRAILING U+001C is kept verbatim - python str.strip() no-args would drop it
BOUNDARY (impl-review r2): class members at the boundary (U+00A0/U+3000) ARE trimmed - collapse then space-only strip matches JS .trim() post-collapse
